svg.text: Positive-quadrant virtual training mapping for double-ended SiPM geometry
Use reflections in x and z, not 90-degree rotations, so x-running and z-running fiber families stay distinct.
Positive training point (x,z) becomes virtual labels (x,z), (-x,z), (x,-z), (-x,-z).
The arrows show folding direction for test events: a measured point in any quadrant folds to (abs(x), abs(z)).
Mappings are source positive-quadrant copy -> virtual quadrant copy.
Each reflection is self-inverse, so the same rule can be read backward when folding test events.
